criteria_verification.notes: Mic button added to input row with Icons.mic/Icons.stop states, _recording flag, elapsed indicator, and onPressed guard preventing interaction when _sending || _ended || _voiceUnavailable. One turn at a time enforced.
_sendVoiceTurn() adds transcript to _turns as user TurnEntry first (line ~219), then tutor answer as second TurnEntry (line ~222), preserving exact order as required.

VoiceUnavailable catch sets _voiceUnavailable=true with exact copy message. Amber Container rendered when flag set (lines ~319-327). Mic remains visible but onPressed=null when unavailable (line ~349).
TransportError catch in _sendVoiceTurn() calls showConnectionProblem(context) (lines ~257-260), preserving existing error handling. Recording data not cleared, allowing retry.

Try-catch in _toggleMic() around recorder.start() catches permission errors and sets message 'This app needs microphone access to record your questions' (lines ~166-170). Typing functionality unaffected.

All 5 refusal errors handled with dedicated catch blocks: UnsupportedAudioFormat (~233-237), EmptyRecording (~238-242), UnintelligibleQuery (~243-247), QueryTooLong (~248-252), RecordingTooLarge (~253-256). Error cleared on next recording (line ~151).
Mic button onPressed guard (_sending || _ended || _voiceUnavailable) ? null : _toggleMic ensures mic disabled when _ended flag set by _endSession().
_send() method unchanged from original. TextField and send button functionality preserved. Voice features added alongside, not replacing text input. Regression prevented.
flutter analyze on session_screen.dart and session_screen_test.dart returns 'No issues found!' All lint warnings (unnecessary_non_null_assertion, unused_local_variable) fixed.
